response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest_days, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), mix_averages AS (SELECT order_type_mix, AVG(avg_short_interest_days) AS mix_avg_short_interest FROM transaction_averages GROUP BY order_type_mix) SELECT a.transref, a.order_type_mix, a.avg_short_interest_days, a.avg_option_volume_ratio, a.avg_short_interest_days / m.mix_avg_short_interest AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages AS a JOIN mix_averages AS m ON a.order_type_mix IS m.order_type_mix ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC, a.transref LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The order type mix average gives each transaction equal weight, regardless of how many sentiment records it has.

alternatives.interpretation: Give each sentiment record equal weight when calculating the order type mix average.
